### American Banker Honors Regions’ Kate Danella as One of the 25 Most Powerful Women in Banking


Oct 1, 2026


*Regions Bank executive earns this national recognition for the fifth consecutive year based on leadership, business performance, and customer impact.*


BIRMINGHAM, Ala.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Regions Bank](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.regions.com%2F&esheet=54614581&newsitemid=20261001247853&lan=en-US&anchor=Regions+Bank&index=1&md5=5611f174842c7bc75a5d2af93c9311eb) on Thursday announced[Chief Administrative Officer Kate Danella](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdoingmoretoday.com%2Fregions-financial-announces-upcoming-retirement-of-dave-keenan-and-new-executive-leadership-appointments%2F&esheet=54614581&newsitemid=20261001247853&lan=en-US&anchor=Chief+Administrative+Officer+Kate+Danella&index=2&md5=f7b0b34d2f9cb4898e076f4d8960e91b) has once again been named by American Banker magazine as one of the “[25 Most Powerful Women in Banking](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.americanbanker.com%2Flist%2F2026-the-most-powerful-women-in-banking&esheet=54614581&newsitemid=20261001247853&lan=en-US&anchor=25+Most+Powerful+Women+in+Banking&index=3&md5=97fda852c38a486c079bf1dff9ea6b79) .”


Regions Bank's Kate Danella has been named one of the 25 Most Powerful Women in Banking by American Banker.


This is the fifth consecutive year for Danella to earn this honor, which is based on her track record of solid leadership, strong business performance, and contributions to customers and communities.


**Why the American Banker Recognition Matters:**


Danella, who served as head of Consumer Banking for Regions before recently being announced as Chief Administrative Officer, takes a customer-centric view with every decision, which is evidenced by[Regions’ #1 ranking for Customer Satisfaction among Regional Bank Websites](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdoingmoretoday.com%2Fregions-bank-ranked-no-1-in-jd-power-2026-u-s-online-banking-satisfaction-study%2F&esheet=54614581&newsitemid=20261001247853&lan=en-US&anchor=Regions%27+%231+ranking+for+Customer+Satisfaction+among+Regional+Bank+Websites&index=4&md5=8256657bc435ee1e9fe7b9977f018fc4) according to JD Power. She is known for her commitment to ensuring a seamless customer experience and working hand-in-hand with teams developing ways banking can be easier, more intuitive, and more beneficial to consumers and businesses.


Danella’s recognition also reflects Regions Bank’s continued focus on[advancing digital banking](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdoingmoretoday.com%2Fregions-launches-digital-direct-deposit-switcher-to-simplify-account-setup%2F&esheet=54614581&newsitemid=20261001247853&lan=en-US&anchor=advancing+digital+banking&index=5&md5=b3735650c8604088c0353bd8abba6c17) experiences while supporting more long-term growth across[Consumer Banking](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.regions.com%2Fpersonal-banking&esheet=54614581&newsitemid=20261001247853&lan=en-US&anchor=Consumer+Banking&index=6&md5=9a5f1fd8e6050e4c087f1a4f5f9283ba) ,[Corporate Banking](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.regions.com%2Fcommercial-banking&esheet=54614581&newsitemid=20261001247853&lan=en-US&anchor=Corporate+Banking&index=7&md5=3c55fa8194fad59af525ee03e6c69f01) and[Wealth Management](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.regions.com%2Fwealth-management&esheet=54614581&newsitemid=20261001247853&lan=en-US&anchor=Wealth+Management&index=8&md5=03264799a08a9cb05e5a77a0af94fcc5) .


**About American Banker’s Most Powerful Women in Banking:**


American Banker’s “The Most Power Women in Banking” program recognizes senior executives whose leadership drives meaningful results while making a positive impact on customers, employees and communities. The 2026 list marks the program’s 24th year.


Danella has earned a place on American Banker’s “The Most Powerful Women in Banking” list for five consecutive years and has received various overall recognitions from American Banker over the last eight consecutive years.


**Leadership Perspective:**


“Kate’s leadership continues to strengthen Regions Bank in meaningful ways for our associates, customers, communities and shareholders,” said **John Turner, Chairman, President and CEO of Regions Financial Corp** . “Kate combines strategic vision with a deep commitment to delivering an exceptional client experience. This latest recognition reflects the continued impact she has across our company and throughout the banking industry.”


“As financial professionals, we have a tremendous responsibility to not only help customers reach their goals, but also to create the next generation of innovation and growth as we reach more clients,” **Danella said** . “In every season, we will build on our strengths, envision the future, innovate with purpose, and[deliver experiences that create more long-term value](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdoingmoretoday.com%2Fregions-bank-launches-personalized-insights-for-mobile-banking-customers%2F&esheet=54614581&newsitemid=20261001247853&lan=en-US&anchor=deliver+experiences+that+create+more+long-term+value&index=9&md5=a7f504f96e363feb5e01b652b4f491ba) for those we serve.”


**About Kate Danella:**


Danella was[named Chief Administrative Officer for Regions](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdoingmoretoday.com%2Fregions-financial-announces-upcoming-retirement-of-dave-keenan-and-new-executive-leadership-appointments%2F&esheet=54614581&newsitemid=20261001247853&lan=en-US&anchor=named+Chief+Administrative+Officer+for+Regions&index=10&md5=bb6a0fc033a5ea6f295c1654a8e6f028) effective Sept. 1 of this year. She is succeeding longtime Regions CAO Dave Keenan, who is retiring at the end of 2026. Since 2022, Danella had served as[head of Regions’ Consumer Banking group](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdoingmoretoday.com%2Fregions-bank-names-scott-peters-as-chief-transformation-officer-kate-danella-named-head-of-consumer-banking%2F&esheet=54614581&newsitemid=20261001247853&lan=en-US&anchor=head+of+Regions%27+Consumer+Banking+group&index=11&md5=2f4d41a02f75662061fe824e3868eb24) after previously serving as Chief Strategy and Client Experience Officer. The Consumer Banking group includes Regions’ retail branch network, along with[Regions Mortgage and Home Improvement Financing](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.regions.com%2Fpersonal-banking%2Fhome-loans&esheet=54614581&newsitemid=20261001247853&lan=en-US&anchor=Regions+Mortgage+and+Home+Improvement+Financing&index=12&md5=b22c01342f611b85de49bf29043b5096) . Together, Consumer Banking is the largest line of business for the bank.


Danella joined Regions in 2015 as Wealth Strategy and Effectiveness Executive, later leading[Private Wealth Management](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.regions.com%2Fwealth-management%2Fprivate-wealth-management&esheet=54614581&newsitemid=20261001247853&lan=en-US&anchor=Private+Wealth+Management&index=13&md5=0a9872c8f2ac7f94cffb7bcd23f58a3d) and serving as head of Strategic Planning and Consumer Bank Products and Origination Partnerships. Before Regions, Danella held leadership roles for 13 years in sales, strategy, client services and marketing for Capital Group Companies.


The[full list of this year’s “The Most Powerful Women in Banking” honorees](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.americanbanker.com%2Flist%2F2026-the-most-powerful-women-in-banking&esheet=54614581&newsitemid=20261001247853&lan=en-US&anchor=full+list+of+this+year%27s+%22The+Most+Powerful+Women+in+Banking%22+honorees&index=14&md5=29f434454850f1bd6a5beeca70bd07ae) and[a profile of Danella in the magazine](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.americanbanker.com%2Fnews%2F2026-the-most-powerful-women-in-banking-15-kate-danella-regions-financial&esheet=54614581&newsitemid=20261001247853&lan=en-US&anchor=a+profile+of+Danella+in+the+magazine&index=15&md5=a04d2723d95bc72bff435f7bb1c6962d) are available to read.


**Other Notable Honors from American Banker:**


This honor is the second time American Banker has recognized Regions’ leadership this year. In June, the publication named[Head of Treasury Management Bryan Ford](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdoingmoretoday.com%2Famerican-banker-names-regions-banks-bryan-ford-among-most-innovative-people-in-finance%2F&esheet=54614581&newsitemid=20261001247853&lan=en-US&anchor=Head+of+Treasury+Management+Bryan+Ford&index=16&md5=dfda16b97325eb366bab2fe474d6a557) to its[Most Innovative People in Finance list](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.americanbanker.com%2Flist%2Fthe-most-innovative-people-in-finance-2026&esheet=54614581&newsitemid=20261001247853&lan=en-US&anchor=Most+Innovative+People+in+Finance+list&index=17&md5=6bc5550045cb8f0a0798a25f917bedff) .


**Frequently Asked Questions:**


- **Why was Kate Danella recognized by American Banker?**
American Banker recognized Kate Danella for her leadership, business performance and contributions to customers, associates, and communities across the banking industry.
- **How many times has Kate Danella received this recognition?**
Kate Danella has been named one of American Banker’s Most Powerful Women in Banking for five consecutive years and has received overall recognitions from the publication for eight consecutive years.
- **What is Kate Danella’s role at Regions Bank?**
Kate Danella serves as Chief Administration Officer of Regions Bank and previously led the company’s Consumer Banking group, the largest line of business at Regions.


**About Regions Financial Corporation**


Regions Financial Corporation (NYSE:RF), with $161 billion in assets, is a member of the S&P 500 Index and is one of the nation’s largest full-service providers of consumer and commercial banking, wealth management, and mortgage products and services. Regions serves customers across the South, Midwest and Texas, and through its subsidiary, Regions Bank, operates more than 1,200 banking offices and more than 1,750 ATMs. Regions Bank is an Equal Housing Lender and Member FDIC. Additional information about Regions and its full line of products and services can be found at[www.regions.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.regions.com%2F&esheet=54614581&newsitemid=20261001247853&lan=en-US&anchor=www.regions.com&index=18&md5=cf8a82672feb6c62b34da1125fd62657) .
